what_this_is: Every free discovery lane folded into one identity graph. Observations merge only on a STRONG key -- address (directionals kept), ten-digit phone, or a brand-scoped property code -- and never on a name, which only proposes an identity. A contradicting strong key blocks the merge outright. Market membership is decided by the committed market-membership contract on the market's declared geography. Nothing here is policy evidence and nothing here publishes.
